description: This Java interface defines a repository for TaskbarItem entities, providing a method to find taskbar items associated with a specific session ordered by their index.

classes.name: TaskbarItemRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for TaskbarItem entities, extending JpaRepository.

methods.name: findBySessionIdOrderByOrderIndexAsc
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaskbarItem entities associated with the specified session ID, ordered by their order index in ascending order.
